newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: FOCUS-Swissotel sells US hotels to Blackstone.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Swissotel sells US hotels to Blackstone.

text.p: Swissotel, the hotel management unit of SAirGroup, on Thursday said it had sold its four luxury hotels in the United States to an affiliate of the Blackstone Group, a New York-based investment bank.
The deal heralds the birth of a partnership that will help Swissotel achieve its goal of managing 60 hotels worldwide by year 2000, a Swissotel spokesman said.
"A letter of intent calls for the two companies to grow jontly," the spokesman said.
The concept behind the partnership is that Blackstone will continue its recent path of acquiring hotel properties in North America and Europe and Swissotel will manage these.
As part of the deal, Blackstone has acquired a 25 percent stake in Swissotel's U.S. hotel management company.
Swissotel will continue to manage the four properties, which include the 550-room New York Drake Swissotel. The other hotels are located in Atlanta, Boston and Chicago.
Swissotel currently manages 15 hotels in Europe, the Middle East, Asia and North America but has set its sights on expanding globally, primarily in Asia.
It is part of the SAirGroup, which includes airline Swissair.
The sales price for the four hotels was not given but industry analysts estimated it at around $400 million.
The hotels are valued at around $300 million on Swissotel's books, which would give a book profit of around $100 million.
"This is an important strategic move for us," the Swissotel statement said, quoting SAirRelations' president and chief executive Wolfgang Werle.
"It not only provides a platform for the expansion of Swissotel; it also allows our shareholder to see a return on its U.S. investment," it added.
Blackstone Real Estate Partners II L.P. is part of the Blackstone Group, a privately-held investment bank.
Blackstone has acquired more than $3.5 billion worth of real estate in North America and Europe since 1993, including controlling interests in 40 full-service hotels valued in excess of $1.5 billion.
Swissotel was a problem for SAirGroup for many years but finally returned to profitability in 1996 when it posted an operating profit of 41 million francs on operating revenue of 294 million.
